en: Color-tinted historic street scene showing a broad, tree-lined avenue with multi-story European townhouses on the left and a large, stately building behind a wooden fence and tall trees on the right. Pedestrians stand along the sidewalk, a cart is visible on the street, and a tram can be seen in the distance. The top left has the printed word 'Graz.' and the top right has 'Humboldtstrasse.' in red script.
